subject: Private deployment: networking readiness checklist + SOW request
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sanjay Patel <sanjay@finsecure.com>, Alex Green <alex.green@clearvault.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 4 Apr 2028 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Private deployment: networking readiness checklist + SOW request

Hi Sanjay / Alex —

Thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and our proposed next steps so your NetOps and procurement teams can evaluate Private VPC deployment for FinSecure: 

Summary of where we landed:
- Preferred deployment: Private VPC (customer-managed VPC in AWS) to meet data isolation and compliance requirements.
- Alternatives considered: Hosted API (insufficient for data residency) and Dedicated (good for predictability but still runs through Redwood-managed egress).

Network items we need to confirm from your side:
1) Preferred connectivity pattern: PrivateLink (interface endpoints) vs VPC Peering. You mentioned security team favors PrivateLink for explicit control — confirm.
2) Egress model: will FinSecure require static outbound IPs (NAT) from your VPCs, or do you prefer our outbound proxy? If static IPs, please share /24 or /28 ranges.
3) Allowlist: public-facing allowlist is required if you choose PrivateLink. Provide the NetOps contact and any current allowlist templates.
4) Certificate/SNI: We support mutual TLS or customer-provided TLS for PrivateLink. Clarify if you require client cert mutual auth.
5) KMS/HSM: Any requirement to use a customer KMS for request encryption at rest?
6) Maintenance windows & RTO: target hours for upgrades/maintenance that we should avoid.

Requested artifacts (attached):
- Network diagram template (PDF) — fill in your subnets & NACLs.
- Draft SOW (DOCX) — high level commercial & timeline for a 6-week PoC + production roll.

Next steps we propose:
- You: Share NetOps contact + filled network diagram by EOD Tue (2028-04-10).
- Redwood: We’ll produce an updated SOW and Ops runbook once we see networking details.
- Schedule a short NetOps-to-NetOps call (30 min) to walk through connector specifics and IP routing.

Please reply with the NetOps POC and any gating items. Happy to loop in our infra engineer (Ben) on the call.

Thanks,
Marissa
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

--
attachments: sow-draft-v1.docx, requested-network-diagram-template.pdf
From: Sanjay Patel <sanjay@finsecure.com>

Cc: Alex Green <alex.green@clearvault.io>
Date: Thu, 4 Apr 2028 17:11:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Private deployment: networking readiness checklist + SOW request

Marissa —

Appreciate the clear recap. A few notes from our side after circulating with NetOps and security: 

1) Connectivity: Security team prefers PrivateLink (interface endpoints) for the control plane. They want explicit VPC endpoint policies.
2) Egress: We need static outbound IPs for a subset of services (audit/logging endpoints). NetOps can provide a /29 set for testing and a larger CIDR for prod if required.
3) Mutual TLS: We are open to TLS+SNI. Mutual TLS is preferred for internal services but for the Redwood connector we can evaluate client certs during the PoC.
4) KMS: We must use our AWS KMS for at-rest key management if data keys are customer-managed. We will include key ARN in the network diagram.
5) Maintenance: No maintenance windows between 07:00-19:00 PT Mon-Fri for customer-facing endpoints.

NetOps POC: Alex Green (alex.green@clearvault.io) is coordinating with our infra team. Alex will fill the network diagram template and return by next Tuesday (10 Apr).

Attached below is an initial checklist from NetOps (copied inline). Let us know if Redwood needs any additional IAM roles or cross-account access to support deployment.

—Sanjay

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Sanjay Patel <sanjay@finsecure.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 4 Apr 2028 19:25:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Private deployment: networking readiness checklist + SOW request

Hi Sanjay — thanks for the quick turnaround. A couple technical clarifications from the infra side so the NetOps diagram can be completed correctly: 

1) PrivateLink specifics: For interface endpoints we’ll ask for the endpoint ENIs to be in at least two AZs for HA. Please include preferred subnets per AZ.
2) Security groups: We will provide an inbound SG that needs to be paired with your endpoint. If you have a managed NACL policy, note differences.
3) Outbound NAT: If you give us a /29 for test egress, we will use those IPs to pin allowlist entries. For production, we recommend a /24 for token service endpoints to avoid frequent churn.
4) TLS/SNI: If you can provide SANs and the preferred SNI hostname, we can support cert pinning on our side. If you require mutual TLS, we’ll need a sample client cert chain to validate in the PoC.
5) Audit logs: Are you sending audit logs to a customer-managed Splunk/S3? We can stream request-level logs to a customer endpoint; please specify preferred destination (S3 bucket ARN or Splunk HTTP endpoint).

Action items from Redwood infra:
- I’ll produce a minimal endpoint configuration (security group, expected ports, AZ subnet guidance) and send it to Alex by EOD Mon (2028-04-08).
- We’ll sketch a PoC test plan that includes connectivity smoke tests and end-to-end latency checks.

If you prefer, we can do a NetOps pairing meeting Mon afternoon (30 min) — what time works for Alex?

Thanks,
Ben
Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Alex Green <alex.green@clearvault.io>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sanjay Patel <sanjay@finsecure.com>
Date: Fri, 5 Apr 2028 08:14:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Private deployment: networking readiness checklist + SOW request

Ben / Marissa —

Thanks, Ben. Quick answers from NetOps (I filled the attached network diagram and kept notes inline):
- Subnets: us-west-2a /26 for endpoint ENIs, us-west-2b /26 for HA.
- Test egress: providing 3 static IPs (/29) next week for connectivity smoke tests. Prod ranges will be scheduled in procurement.
- SNI hostnames: api.finsecure.prod (will provide SANs).
- KMS ARN: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:987654321:key/abcd-ef01-2345 (will include key policy for access).
- Logs: pushing request logs to our S3 bucket arn:aws:s3:::finsecure-logs-redwood with cross-account role.

I can do a NetOps pairing on Mon 2028-04-08 at 14:00 PT — works for our team.

Attaching: filled-network-diagram.pdf (contains subnets + egress IPs).

—Alex
